logline: 서자로 태어나 아버지를 아버지라 부르지 못한 소년이, 집을 떠나 도술을 익히고 무리를 이끈다.
destination: 산속 활빈당의 본거지 — 그가 세운 새로운 자리
protagonist: 상투를 튼 열여섯 소년, 무명 저고리에 짚신
setting: 조선 시대, 사대부 저택과 깊은 산중
anchor: a sixteen-year-old Korean boy with a topknot, plain hemp jeogori and straw sandals
palette: ink-wash mountains, hanji cream, deep indigo night, lantern amber

beats.beat: 소년이 마당에서 아버지를 향해 큰절을 올린다.
beats.visual: a boy in hemp clothes bowing to the ground before a stern robed nobleman in a tiled-roof courtyard
beats.motion: he lowers into the bow toward the man, the nobleman turns away, sleeves swing

beats.beat: 소년이 밤중에 봇짐을 지고 대문을 나선다.
beats.visual: a boy with a bundle on his back stepping out through a heavy gate into a moonlit lane
beats.motion: the gate swings shut behind him, he strides forward down the lane, his bundle rocks

beats.beat: 산속 바위 위에서 소년이 손을 펼친다.
beats.visual: a boy standing on a mist-wrapped mountain boulder with both palms opened before him
beats.motion: mist coils up around him toward his hands, pine tops sway, his sleeves lift

beats.visual: several boys in the same hemp jeogori and straw sandals standing apart across a misty ridge, pine silhouettes between them
beats.motion: the duplicate figures fan outward across the ridge, mist streams between them

beats.beat: 관아 곳간 문이 저절로 활짝 열린다.
beats.visual: the heavy doors of a government storehouse swinging open at night, grain sacks stacked inside
beats.motion: the doors swing outward, a lantern gutters, dust rolls out over the threshold

beats.beat: 굶주린 마을 사람들이 쌀자루를 받아 든다.
beats.visual: villagers in worn hanbok receiving rice sacks at dawn in a mountain hamlet, breath steaming
beats.motion: the sacks pass forward into their arms, breath clouds rise, straw scatters

beats.beat: 관군의 창끝이 산길을 가득 메우고 올라온다.
beats.visual: a line of helmeted soldiers with spears climbing a narrow mountain path toward a ridge
beats.motion: the soldiers climb up the path toward the ridge, spear tips sway, dust rises behind

beats.beat: 텅 빈 산마루에 안개와 짚신 자국만 남는다.
beats.visual: an empty mountain ridge in morning mist, straw sandal prints in the wet earth, pines beyond
beats.motion: mist rolls across the ridge, the prints fill with water, pine branches stir

withheld: 홍길동이 바다 건너 율도국을 세워 임금이 된다는 결말
